\n

Earlier printings of this book carried words and remarks that were neither edifying to a reader nor kind to the people in the story. In this edition they have been reworded. Where the story could stand as the author told it, it does; where a remark could not be mended, a kinder and more fitting one stands in its place. A few phrases about salvation and prayer now follow historic Christian teaching. Salvation is God’s work from first to last.
